answer: A saffron-trading marketplace resists sybils by requiring each seller agent to stake a refundable deposit that unlocks only after a terrace of verified trades. A single identity must build a canyon of history: every sale is sealed by the buyer's attestation, and a fresh account starts with zero trust, so creating many fake sellers costs deposits and time while yielding no sales. Attackers who fake volume pay real stake and gain no reputation, making the attack unprofitable.
